title: Hiking Backpack 1000D – 25–50L Hard-Wearing
descriptionHtml:
A backpack that handles tough trips

A cheap backpack easily breaks at the seams and zippers when loaded heavily. Out in the wilderness, that's the last thing you want to happen.

Heavy-duty 1000D nylon

This backpack is made of hard-wearing 1000D nylon and holds between 25 and 50 liters. It has several compartments and sits comfortably even when fully packed.

Features

  • Hard-wearing 1000D nylon
  • Holds 25–50 liters
  • Several compartments for good organization
  • Comfortable, adjustable shoulder straps
  • For hiking, camping, fishing and hunting

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
